_comment: Hand-read 2026-11-21: what each listed company posts for its earnings calls (layers/terminal/server/calls/). EDGAR exhibits are found by the reader itself; this lists the transcripts, remarks and replay audio a company posts on its own hosts, and why a company has none. Re-read with the source-audit notes in docs/source-audit.md.

companies.gap: Every call since 2018 is read: Word files on Microsoft’s CDN until January 2022, its transcript pages since.
Amazon posts no transcript. It links each call’s replay file (WAV until 2024, MP3 since), all still up from Q1 2020 except Q2 2021; 2018 and 2019 replays are gone. We transcribe them.
companies.prompt: Amazon.com quarterly earnings conference call. Investor relations opens, then CEO Andy Jassy and CFO Brian Olsavsky discuss results for AWS, the North America and International segments, advertising, capital expenditures and guidance, followed by analyst questions.

companies.gap: Transcripts from Q1 2022 on. Earlier ones were on Alphabet’s retired abc.xyz static site and now answer 404; its releases on EDGAR carry no outlook.

Oracle posts no transcript. Its webcast replay sits behind a registration page on q4 (events.q4inc.com), with no media file the company links, so we do not transcribe it. Its outlook is given only on the call.
Transcripts from Q4 2023 on. AMD’s results page links none for 2020 to 2023, and its 2018 files are gone; the releases on EDGAR carry the outlook back to 2018.
Arm posts FactSet transcripts, but investors.arm.com refuses automated clients (HTTP 403), so we read only its 6-K exhibits.
Broadcom posts no transcript, investors.broadcom.com refuses automated clients (HTTP 403), and its replay needs registration. Its release states the next quarter’s revenue outlook, which we read.
Cerebras posts no transcript we could find; its IR site refuses automated clients (HTTP 403).
Intel posted each call as an MP3 from 2018 to Q1 2021, which we transcribe, and prepared remarks with no Q&A since Q3 2021. The Q2 2021 call has only a registration-gated webcast.
companies.prompt: Intel quarterly earnings conference call. Investor relations opens, then the CEO and CFO discuss results for the data center and client businesses, gross margin, capital spending and the outlook, followed by analyst questions.

companies.gap: Marvell posts no transcript. Its webcast replay sits behind a registration page on chorus call, with no media file the company links, so we do not transcribe it. Its release states the next quarter’s outlook; those before April 2021 are under Marvell Technology Group’s CIK.
NVIDIA posts transcripts only from Q1 FY2026 (May 2025); before that, the CFO commentary and release on EDGAR carry the outlook back to 2018.
Transcripts from Q4 FY2018 (November 2018) on; Qualcomm posted none for the three calls before. Its release on EDGAR prints the outlook table.

TSMC posts LSEG transcripts, but investor.tsmc.com answers automated clients with a bot challenge, so we read only its 6-Ks. Those before October 2019 put the release in the 6-K itself, with no exhibit, so our reader takes nothing from them.
Astera Labs posts no transcript; its IR site refuses automated clients (HTTP 403). Its release states the next quarter’s outlook.
Arista posts no transcript. Its webcast replay sits behind a registration page on q4 (events.q4inc.com), with no media file the company links, so we do not transcribe it.
Credo posts no transcript we could find. Its release states the next quarter’s outlook.

Applied Optoelectronics posts no transcript. Its webcast replay sits behind a registration page on notified and q4, with no media file the company links, so we do not transcribe it. Its release states the next quarter’s outlook.
Transcripts from fiscal Q1 2022 on. Earlier files were on a retired IR file host that now answers 404.
Coherent posts no transcript we could find; ir.coherent.com refuses automated clients (HTTP 403).
Fabrinet posts no transcript we could find; its IR site refuses automated clients (HTTP 403).
Lumentum posts no transcript we could find. Its release states the next quarter’s outlook.
Celestica posts no transcript; its IR site refuses automated clients (HTTP 403), so the replay files it linked from 2019 to 2023 can’t be fetched. It files 6-Ks as a foreign private issuer.
Transcripts from Q1 FY2019 (June 2018) on; the one 2018 call before that has a link whose file is gone.
Prepared remarks (and three transcripts) from fiscal Q2 2020 on; Super Micro posted no call files during its 2018-2019 restatement. No Q&A in the remarks.
Akamai posts no transcript; its IR site refuses automated clients (HTTP 403).

IREN filed one call transcript on EDGAR (May 2026). Its webcast replay sits behind a registration page on notified (edge.media-server.com), with no media file the company links, so we do not transcribe it.
Nebius posts a shareholder letter (read from its 6-K) and streams the call on YouTube, which we do not download. Its CIK filed as Yandex until July 2024, so no earlier call is read.
Applied Digital posts no transcript. Its webcast replay sits behind a registration page on q4 (events.q4inc.com), with no media file the company links, so we do not transcribe it.
Cipher posts no transcript; its IR site refuses automated clients (HTTP 403). Its business update deck is read from the 8-K.
Core Scientific posts prepared remarks, no Q&A, from Q1 2026 on; before that only a registration-gated Chorus Call webcast.
Galaxy’s IR site refuses automated clients (HTTP 403); we found no transcript at a fixed address. It streams the call on YouTube, which we do not download.
Every Hut 8 Corp. call since its first (March 2024). Hut 8’s Q3 2026 transcript was not posted yet on 2026-11-21.
Riot posts no transcript. Its webcast replay sits behind a registration page on notified (edge.media-server.com), with no media file the company links, so we do not transcribe it.

TeraWulf posts no transcript. Its webcast replay sits behind a registration page on viavid, with no media file the company links, so we do not transcribe it. Its CIK filed as IKONICS until the December 2021 merger, so no earlier call is read.
AEP posts no transcript; it posts every call’s audio as an MP3 back to 2018, which we transcribe.
companies.prompt: American Electric Power quarterly earnings conference call. Investor relations opens, then CEO Bill Fehrman and CFO Trevor Mihalik discuss operating earnings, load growth from data centers, the capital plan and guidance, followed by analyst questions.

companies.gap: Bloom posts no transcript we could find. Its release states its full-year outlook.
Entergy’s site terms bar automated reading, so we read only its EDGAR filings.
Pinnacle West posts no transcript we could find.
WEC posts no transcript we could find; its site refuses automated clients (HTTP 403).
Williams posts edited transcripts, but investor.williams.com refuses automated clients (HTTP 403), so we read only its 8-K exhibits.
